newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Netcomm says expects first half loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Netcomm says expects first half loss.

text.p: Computer modem manufacturer Netcomm Ltd said on Friday it expected to report a significant loss for the half year on revenues that were well down on the previous corresponding period.
For the half year to December 31, 1995, Netcomm reported a net profit of A$1.63 million on revenues of A$26.75 million.

Netcomm cited difficult economic and personal computer industry conditions for the poorer outlook. It said there was industry-wide excess inventory and product pricing pressures, along with buying restraint pending release 56Kbs technology.
Also on Friday, Netcomm said a unit of National Australia Bank Ltd had taken a 33.3 percent stake in Connect.Com, an Internet service provider owned by Netcomm and AAP Telecommunications.

The deal through National Australia Investment Capital Ltd values Connect.Com at A$15 million to A$19.5 million and Netcomm's 33.3 percent stake at A$5 million to A$6.5 million or about 35 cents per Netcomm share, a value which Netcomm directors said was not reflected in the current share price.
By 12.40 p.m. (0140 GMT), Netcomm shares were nine cents lower at 68 cents on turnover of 97,067 shares.
